notes.title: [Update] Unearthed Inc: The Lost Temple v1.3
notes.content:
Unearthed Inc: The Lost Temple v1.3 is available now. Here is the changelog. 

- Bug fix: A glitch you can access the puzzles inside the cabinet in mine station before you open it
- You can now skip mine cart riding scene after 4 tries
- The difficulty will keep decreasing as you die in the final boss fight
- Performance improvement

Hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: [Update] Unearthed Inc: The Lost Temple v1.2
notes.content:
Unearthed Inc: The Lost Temple v1.2 is available now. Here is the changelog.

- Bug fix: Item stays small when is taken out from inventory
- Bug fix: Restarting level does not work properly sometimes
- Bug fix: Headset height is incorrect for Oculus
- Droid talks less frequently
- Some game balance

Hope you enjoy the game!
